answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 44492 Country: India Title: As per Islam is hunting of animals for eating their meat halal or haram Question: As per Islam is hunting of animals for eating their meat halal or haram? Answer ID: 44492 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 488/387/B=1434) Yes, it is lawful to hunt halal animals to eat them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
